verdict.rationale: Browserbase's dashboard Optimize tool reads an Agent run's event history and generates suggestions to improve the system prompt, and can convert a run into a reusable script — a concrete instance of AI-generated insight from in-product data. However this is narrowly scoped to agent-run optimization rather than broader data/analytics insights across sessions or usage patterns. Missing for 10: evidence of insights/suggestions derived from aggregated session data, usage analytics, or business-metric trends beyond single-run prompt optimization, and any independent corroboration of the Optimize tool's effectiveness.
